reader.requirement: At --std 85 the scope of a SEARCH (both formats) ends at an END-SEARCH at the same level of nesting, at a separator period, or at an ELSE or END-IF of a previous IF; no other phrase ends it, so an unterminated SEARCH where an imperative statement is required (an EVALUATE WHEN, an in-line PERFORM body) is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: whether a phrase associates with an open statement under the formats available at the edition (ConstructRegistry.IsAvailable); SEARCH's AT END formats carry no construct, so the answer is the same at 85
a subscripted identifier-1 is a 2023 construct, refused at 85 (not part of scope termination)

reader.notes: Scope ends where the grammar's searchStatement/searchAllStatement alternative ends (END_SEARCH? then the enclosing ELSE/END-IF/DOT), and an unterminated SEARCH in an imperative position is refused by ProcedureFormatPass (COBOL2796), the same at every edition. COBOL2796 and COBOL2409 cite the 2023 text at --std 85; the refusal is right.
